name: Brainrot Deaths
description: Brainrot New Best texts and death sound effects at specific percentages.

enabled.name: Enable Brainrot Texts
enabled.description: Replace the New Best text with a brainrot text for the percent you died at.

sounds-enabled.name: Enable Death Sounds
sounds-enabled.description: Play a sound effect when you die at a percent that has one.

wait-for-sound.name: Wait For Sound Before Respawn
wait-for-sound.description: Do not respawn until the death sound effect has finished playing.

use-presets.name: Use Preset Percents
use-presets.description: Use the built in brainrot texts and sounds (67, 69, 99, and more).

random-for-others.name: Random Text For Other Percents
random-for-others.description: If a percent has no preset or custom entry, show a random brainrot text.

random-sound-for-others.name: Random Sound For Other Percents
random-sound-for-others.description: If a percent has no preset or custom entry, play a random preset sound.

normal-mode-only.name: Normal Mode Only
normal-mode-only.description: Do not trigger texts and sounds in Practice Mode.

volume.name: Sound Volume
volume.description: Volume of the death sound effect.

custom-percent-1.name: Custom 1: Percent
custom-percent-1.description: Percent to trigger on. 0 means off.

custom-sound-1.name: Custom 1: Sound
custom-sound-1.description: Pick an audio file, or leave empty for no sound.

custom-percent-2.name: Custom 2: Percent
custom-percent-2.description: Percent to trigger on. 0 means off.

custom-sound-2.name: Custom 2: Sound
custom-sound-2.description: Pick an audio file, or leave empty for no sound.

custom-percent-3.name: Custom 3: Percent
custom-percent-3.description: Percent to trigger on. 0 means off.

custom-sound-3.name: Custom 3: Sound
custom-sound-3.description: Pick an audio file, or leave empty for no sound.
